title: Generic VAST Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Generic VAST adapter

url.description: The full URL the adapter will call (verbatim) to fetch a VAST response.

cpm.description: Fallback CPM (EUR) used only when the VAST response does not declare a CPM <Pricing> element.

unwrap.description: When true, VAST <Wrapper> ads are unwrapped by recursively fetching VASTAdTagURI until an <InLine> is reached, merging wrapper tracking into the final VAST.
